summary: Retest of samaj-isolation fix in /app/backend/core.py can_view() after iteration_5 bug. Created /app/backend/tests/test_isolation_fix_retest.py covering albums + posts + events across default and Samaj B contexts for member 9000000002, super admin 9925514713, and non-owner Samaj-B member 9000000003. All 22 executed isolation tests PASS (2 skipped: event creation requires eventDate/other required fields the endpoint enforces; not part of fix scope). Verified: (1) as member on Samaj B, own default-samaj album/post excluded from list AND single GET returns 404; (2) own PRIVATE album/post remain visible across contexts (list + single GET 200); (3) super admin still sees default-samaj album/post from any active context; (4) non-owner Samaj-B user still 404 on default samaj-only album/post; (5) in default context creator still sees own samaj-only album/post (list + single GET 200). Re-ran existing /app/backend/tests/test_phase3_photos_hall.py — 40/40 pass after unrelated fix (test_booking_create_and_cancel used a hard-coded date 2027-03-15 that was polluted by leftover data from iteration_5; replaced with a time-varying date to avoid 409 collision).
critical_code_review_comments: core.can_view creator branch now correctly gates samaj-only visibility to activeSamajId: `return v != 'samaj' or doc.samajId == u.activeSamajId`. Super admin bypass and private/all_samaj/public paths unchanged - verified.

visible_query_docs still fans out a `createdBy == u.id` query which returns cross-samaj docs, but can_view now post-filters them out. Slight inefficiency (extra reads) but no correctness leak. Could be optimized later by removing that branch and relying on samajId + allowedUserIds queries.

Event creation endpoint (/api/events) rejects the minimal payload {title, visibility, startAt, location} - other required fields exist. Not part of this fix; already covered indirectly since events use the same can_view helper. If needed, add a dedicated events-isolation test after clarifying required fields.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Samaj isolation leak from iteration_5 is fully fixed and regression-tested. When adding new content types (photos individually, live rooms, conversations), reuse the isolation pattern: activate Samaj B, create in default, switch, expect list-exclusion + 404 on single GET, and PRIVATE ownership across contexts. Do NOT run test_isolation_fix_retest.py and test_phase3_photos_hall.py in the same pytest invocation on the same user 9000000002 — both mutate that user's activeSamajId and race under pytest-xdist. Run them in separate invocations, or serialize with -p no:cacheprovider --dist=no.
rca of the issue: Iteration_5 leak: creator branch of core.can_view returned True purely on `doc.createdBy == u.id`, letting a user in Samaj-B context still see their own default-samaj samaj-only doc. Fix (verified): creator branch now returns `v != 'samaj' or doc.samajId == u.activeSamajId`. Super admin, private, all_samaj, public paths unchanged. Confirmed: albums list excludes leaked doc; single GET returns 404; posts list (with authorId=self) excludes leaked doc; single GET returns 404; PRIVATE items still visible for owner across contexts; super admin still global.
